name: Fnac Darty SA
summary: Fnac Darty SA engages in the retail of entertainment and leisure products, consumer electronics, and domestic appliances in France, Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, and the Iberian Peninsula. The company provides consumer electronics, including desktop computers, laptops, tablets, software, printers, e-readers, telephones and office products, and accessories, as well as various connected products; c and photography accessories; televisions and video accessories, such as DVD players, Blu-ray players, and other accessories; and audio items and accessories comprising headphones, docking stations, and related accessories.
